chapter_title.ar: باب فِيهِ نُكَتٌ وَ نُتَفٌ مِنَ التَّنْزِيلِ فِي الْوَلَايَةِ
chapter_title.en: Chapter 108 – Points and pickings from the Revelation regarding the Wilayah

chunks.arabic_text: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ الدَّيْلَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ

translations.bn: আলী ইবন মুহাম্মদ, সahl ইবন জিয়াদ থেকে, মুহাম্মদ ইবন সুলাইমান আল-দাইলামি থেকে, তাঁর পিতা থেকে, আবান ইবন তাগলিব থেকে, আবু আবদিল্লাহ عليه السلام থেকে বর্ণনা করেছেন, যিনি বলেছেন:
translations.de: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, von Sahl ibn Ziyād, von Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān al-Daylamī, von seinem Vater, von Abān ibn Taghlib, von Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, der sagte:
translations.en: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān al-Daylamī, from his father, from Abān ibn Taghlib, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
translations.es: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, de Sahl ibn Ziyād, de Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān al-Daylamī, de su padre, de Abān ibn Taghlib, de Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, quien dijo:
translations.fa: علی بن محمد، از سهل بن زیاد، از محمد بن سلیمان دیلمی، از پدرش، از ابان بن تغلب، از ابوعبدالله علیه السلام روایت کرد که فرمود:
translations.fr: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, d’après Sahl ibn Ziyād, d’après Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān al-Daylamī, d’après son père, d’après Abān ibn Taghlib, d’après Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, qui a dit :
translations.id: Ali ibn Muhammad, dari Sahl ibn Ziyad, dari Muhammad ibn Sulayman al-Daylami, dari ayahnya, dari Aban ibn Taghlib, dari Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, yang berkata:
translations.ru: ʿАли ибн Мухаммад, от Сахля ибн Зияда, от Мухаммада ибн Сулеймана аль-Дайлами, от его отца, от Абана ибн Таглиба, от Абу ʿАбдуллаха عليه السلام, который сказал:
translations.tr: Ali ibn Muhammed, Sahl ibn Ziyad’dan, Muhammed ibn Süleyman ed-Deylemî’den, babasından, Aban ibn Tağlib’den, Ebu Abdullah عليه السلام’dan rivayet etti ki şöyle dedi:
translations.ur: علی بن محمد، سہل بن زیاد سے، محمد بن سلیمان الدیلمی سے، ان کے والد سے، ابان بن تغلب سے، ابو عبداللہ علیہ السلام سے روایت کرتے ہیں، جنہوں نے فرمایا:
translations.zh: 阿里·伊本·穆罕默德，传自萨赫勒·伊本·齐亚德，传自穆罕默德·伊本·苏莱曼·戴拉米，传自其父，传自阿班·伊本·塔格利卜，传自阿布·阿卜杜拉 عليه السلام，他说：

translations.bn: আমি তাঁকে বললাম: “আমি আপনার জন্য কুরবান হই।”
translations.de: Ich sagte zu ihm: „Möge ich für dich geopfert werden.“
translations.en: I said to him, “May I be sacrificed for you.”
translations.es: Le dije: “Que yo sea sacrificado por usted.”
translations.fr: Je lui ai dit : « Que je sois sacrifié pour vous. »
translations.ru: Я сказал ему: «Да буду я принесён в жертву за тебя».
translations.ur: میں نے ان سے عرض کیا: “میں آپ پر قربان ہو جاؤں۔”
translations.zh: 我对他说：“愿我为你献身。”

translations.bn: তাঁর বাণী: “কিন্তু সে কঠিন উপত্যকা অতিক্রম করেনি।”
translations.de: Sein Wort: „Aber er hat den steilen Aufstieg nicht unternommen.“
translations.en: His saying: “But he did not attempt the steep ascent.”
translations.es: Su dicho: “Pero no emprendió la subida empinada.”
translations.fa: سخن او: «پس از گردنه دشوار بالا نرفت.»
translations.fr: Sa parole : « Mais il ne s’est pas engagé dans l’ascension difficile. »
translations.id: Firman-Nya: “Tetapi dia tidak menempuh tanjakan yang sukar itu.”
translations.ru: Его слово: «Но он не попытался преодолеть крутой подъём».
translations.tr: Onun sözü: “Fakat o sarp yokuşa atılmadı.”
translations.ur: اس کا قول: “پھر وہ دشوار گھاٹی پر نہ چڑھا۔”
translations.zh: 他的话：“但他没有攀登那陡坡。”

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ مَنْ أَكْرَمَهُ اللَّهُ بِوَلَايَتِنَا فَقَدْ جَازَ الْعَقَبَةَ وَنَحْنُ تِلْكَ الْعَقَبَةُ الَّتِي مَنِ اقْتَحَمَهَا نَجَا

translations.bn: তখন তিনি عليه السلام বললেন: “আল্লাহ যাকে আমাদের wilayah-এর মাধ্যমে সম্মানিত করেছেন, সে অবশ্যই সেই কঠিন উপত্যকা অতিক্রম করেছে; আর আমরাই সেই কঠিন উপত্যকা, যে তা অতিক্রম করে সে মুক্তি পায়।”
translations.de: Da sagte er عليه السلام: „Wen Allah mit unserer wilayah geehrt hat, der hat gewiss den steilen Aufstieg überwunden, und wir sind jener steile Aufstieg; wer ihn überwindet, wird gerettet.“
translations.en: So he عليه السلام said: “Whoever Allah has honored with our wilayah has indeed crossed the steep ascent, and we are that steep ascent which whoever undertakes it is saved.”
translations.es: Entonces él عليه السلام dijo: “Quien Allah ha honrado con nuestro wilayah, en verdad ha cruzado la subida escarpada, y nosotros somos esa subida escarpada; quien la emprende se salva.”
translations.fa: پس آن حضرت علیه السلام فرمود: «هر کس را که خداوند به ولایت ما گرامی داشته باشد، بی‌گمان از آن گردنه دشوار گذشته است، و ما همان گردنه دشواریم که هر کس از آن بگذرد، نجات می‌یابد.»
translations.fr: Alors il عليه السلام dit : « Quiconque Allah a honoré par notre wilayah a certes franchi l’ascension difficile, et nous sommes cette ascension difficile ; quiconque la franchit est sauvé. »
translations.id: Maka beliau عليه السلام bersabda: “Barang siapa Allah muliakan dengan wilayah kami, sungguh ia telah melampaui tanjakan yang sukar itu, dan kami adalah tanjakan yang sukar itu; siapa pun yang melaluinya akan selamat.”
translations.ru: Тогда он عليه السلام сказал: «Тот, кого Аллах почтил нашей вилайей, уже преодолел этот крутой подъём, а мы и есть тот крутой подъём; кто преодолеет его, тот спасётся».
translations.tr: Bunun üzerine o عليه السلام şöyle buyurdu: “Allah’ın bizim velayetimizle onurlandırdığı kimse gerçekten o sarp yokuşu aşmıştır; biz de o sarp yokuşuz, onu aşan kurtuluşa erer.”
translations.ur: تو انہوں نے علیہ السلام فرمایا: “جسے اللہ نے ہماری ولایت کے ذریعے عزت دی، اس نے یقیناً اس دشوار گھاٹی کو پار کر لیا، اور ہم ہی وہ دشوار گھاٹی ہیں؛ جو اس میں داخل ہوا نجات پا گیا۔”
translations.zh: 于是他 عليه السلام说：“凡真主以我们的wilayah尊荣之人，确已越过那陡坡；而我们就是那陡坡，谁越过它，谁就得救。”

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ فَسَكَتَ فَقَالَ لِي فَهَلَّا أُفِيدُكَ حَرْفًا خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا قُلْتُ بَلَى جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ

translations.bn: তিনি বললেন: তারপর তিনি নীরব হলেন, তারপর আমাকে বললেন, “আমি কি তোমাকে এমন একটি কথা জানাব, যা তোমার জন্য দুনিয়া ও তাতে যা কিছু আছে তার চেয়ে উত্তম?” আমি বললাম, “হ্যাঁ, আমি আপনার জন্য উৎসর্গিত হই।”
translations.de: Er sagte: Dann schwieg er, dann sagte er zu mir: „Soll ich dir ein Wort nennen, das besser für dich ist als die Welt und was immer in ihr ist?“ Ich sagte: „Ja, möge ich für dich geopfert werden.“
translations.en: He said: Then he was silent, then he said to me, “Shall I give you a statement that is better for you than the world and whatever is in it?” I said, “Yes, may I be sacrificed for you.”
translations.es: Dijo: Luego guardó silencio, y después me dijo: “¿Quieres que te diga una palabra que es mejor para ti que el mundo y cuanto hay en él?” Yo dije: “Sí, que yo sea sacrificado por ti.”
translations.fa: فرمود: سپس خاموش شد، آنگاه به من فرمود: «آیا تو را به سخنی آگاه نکنم که برای تو از دنیا و آنچه در آن است بهتر باشد؟» گفتم: «آری، فدایت شوم.»
translations.fr: Il dit : Puis il se tut, puis il me dit : « Voulez-vous que je vous indique une parole meilleure pour vous que le monde et tout ce qu’il contient ? » Je dis : « Oui, que je sois sacrifié pour vous. »
translations.id: Ia berkata: Lalu beliau diam, kemudian beliau berkata kepadaku, “Maukah aku beritahukan kepadamu suatu ucapan yang lebih baik bagimu daripada dunia dan segala isinya?” Aku berkata, “Ya, aku rela dikorbankan untukmu.”
translations.ru: Он сказал: Затем он замолчал, потом сказал мне: «Не сообщить ли тебе слово, которое лучше для тебя, чем мир и то, что в нем?» Я сказал: «Да, да буду я принесен в жертву за тебя».
translations.tr: Dedi ki: Sonra sustu, sonra bana dedi ki: “Sana dünya ve içindekilerden daha hayırlı bir söz söyleyeyim mi?” Ben de dedim ki: “Evet, sana feda olayım.”
translations.ur: انہوں نے فرمایا: پھر وہ خاموش ہو گئے، پھر انہوں نے مجھ سے فرمایا: "کیا میں تمہیں ایک ایسا کلمہ نہ بتاؤں جو تمہارے لیے دنیا اور اس میں جو کچھ ہے اس سے بہتر ہو؟" میں نے عرض کیا: "جی ہاں، میں آپ پر قربان ہو جاؤں۔"
translations.zh: 他说：然后他沉默了，然后对我说：“要我告诉你一句比今世及其中一切都更好的话吗？”我说：“是的，愿我为你牺牲。”

translations.bn: তিনি বললেন: তাঁর কথা: “একটি গর্দান মুক্ত করা।”
translations.de: Er sagte: Sein Wort: „Einen Nacken befreien.“
translations.en: He said: His saying: “The freeing of a neck.”
translations.fa: فرمود: سخن او: «آزاد کردن یک گردن.»
translations.fr: Il dit : Sa parole : « Affranchir un cou. »
translations.tr: Dedi ki: Onun sözü: “Bir boynu özgür bırakmak.”
translations.ur: انہوں نے فرمایا: اس کا قول: "ایک گردن آزاد کرنا۔"
translations.zh: 他说：他的话：“释放一个颈项。”

chunks.arabic_text: ثُمَّ قَالَ النَّاسُ كُلُّهُمْ عَبِيدُ النَّارِ غَيْرَكَ وَأَصْحَابِكَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ فَكَّ رِقَابَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ بِوَلَايَتِنَا أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ

translations.bn: তারপর তিনি বললেন: “তোমরা ও তোমাদের সঙ্গীরা ছাড়া সব মানুষই আগুনের দাস; কারণ আল্লাহ আমাদের ওয়িলায়াত, আহলুল বাইতের মাধ্যমে তোমাদের গর্দানগুলোকে আগুন থেকে মুক্ত করেছেন।”
translations.de: Dann sagte er: „Alle Menschen sind Sklaven des Feuers, außer dir und deinen Gefährten; denn Allah hat eure Nacken durch unsere wilayah, die Ahl al-Bayt, vom Feuer befreit.“
translations.en: Then he said: “All the people are slaves of the Fire except you and your companions, for Allah has freed your necks from the Fire through our wilayah, the Ahl al-Bayt.”
translations.es: Luego dijo: “Toda la gente es esclava del Fuego, excepto tú y tus compañeros, pues Allah ha liberado vuestros cuellos del Fuego por medio de nuestra wilayah, la Ahl al-Bayt.”
translations.fa: سپس فرمود: «همه مردم بردگان آتش‌اند جز تو و یارانت، زیرا خداوند به‌وسیله ولایت ما، اهل‌بیت، گردن‌های شما را از آتش آزاد کرده است.»
translations.fr: Puis il dit : « Tous les gens sont des esclaves du Feu, sauf toi et tes compagnons, car Allah a affranchi vos cous du Feu par notre wilayah, les Ahl al-Bayt. »
translations.id: Kemudian beliau berkata: “Semua manusia adalah hamba-hamba النار, kecuali engkau dan para sahabatmu; karena Allah telah memerdekakan leher-leher kalian dari النار melalui wilayah kami, Ahl al-Bayt.”
translations.ru: Затем он сказал: «Все люди — рабы Огня, кроме тебя и твоих спутников, ибо Аллах освободил ваши шеи от Огня посредством нашей вилайи, Ахль аль-Байт».
translations.tr: Sonra dedi ki: “İnsanların hepsi ateşin kullarıdır; siz ve arkadaşlarınız hariç. Çünkü Allah, bizim velayetimiz, Ehl-i Beyt vasıtasıyla boyunlarınızı ateşten azat etti.”
translations.ur: پھر انہوں نے فرمایا: "تمام لوگ آگ کے غلام ہیں سوائے تمہارے اور تمہارے ساتھیوں کے، کیونکہ اللہ نے ہماری ولایت، اہلِ بیت کے ذریعے تمہاری گردنیں آگ سے آزاد کر دی ہیں۔"
translations.zh: 然后他说：“所有人都是火狱的奴仆，唯独你和你的同伴不是，因为真主借着我们的wilayah，即Ahlal-Bayt，使你们的颈项脱离了火狱。”

en.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the People of the Household; the family of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
en.الْعَقَبَةَ: the steep ascent; interpreted here as the salvific path linked to wilayah
en.بِوَلَايَتِنَا: through our wilayah; through allegiance and devotion to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
en.عَبِيدُ النَّارِ: slaves of the Fire; those bound for punishment
en.فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ: freeing a neck; interpreted here as deliverance from the Fire

seo_questions.bn: ইমাম আল-সাদিক عليه السلام কীভাবে “فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ” এবং “فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ”কে আহলুল বাইতের wilayah-এর সঙ্গে ব্যাখ্যা করেন?
seo_questions.de: Wie erklärt Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام „فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ“ und „فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ“ im Zusammenhang mit der wilayah der Ahl al-Bayt?
seo_questions.en: How does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explain “فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ” and “فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ” in relation to the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt?
seo_questions.es: ¿Cómo explica el Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام “فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ” y “فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ” en relación con el wilayah de la Ahl al-Bayt?
seo_questions.fa: امام صادق علیه السلام «فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ» و «فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ» را در ارتباط با ولایت اهل‌بیت چگونه توضیح می‌دهد؟
seo_questions.fr: Comment l’Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explique-t-il « فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ » et « فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ » en relation avec la wilayah des Ahl al-Bayt ?
seo_questions.id: Bagaimana Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام menjelaskan “فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ” dan “فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ” dalam kaitannya dengan wilayah Ahl al-Bayt?
seo_questions.ru: Как Имам ас-Садик عليه السلام объясняет «فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ» и «فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ» в связи с вилайей Ахль аль-Байт?
seo_questions.tr: İmam es-Sâdık عليه السلام, “فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ” ve “فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ” ifadelerini Ehl-i Beyt’in velayeti bağlamında nasıl açıklar?
seo_questions.ur: امام الصادق علیہ السلام اہلِ بیت کی ولایت کے حوالے سے “فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ” اور “فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ” کی کیسے تفسیر فرماتے ہیں؟
seo_questions.zh: 伊玛目萨迪格 عليه السلام如何从Ahlal-Bayt的wilayah角度解释“فَلَااقْتَحَمَالْعَقَبَةَ”和“فَكُّرَقَبَةٍ”？

summaries.bn: এই হাদিসে “العقبة” এবং “فكّ رقبة”-এর ইমাম-ভিত্তিক তাফসির উপস্থাপিত হয়েছে, যেখানে আহলুল বাইত عليهم السلام-এর wilayah-কে নাজাত ও আগুন থেকে মুক্তির পথ বলা হয়েছে।
summaries.de: Dieser Hadith bietet eine imambezogene Tafsir der Ausdrücke „al-ʿaqaba“ und „fakku raqaba“ und deutet sie durch die wilayah der Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام als Weg des Heils und der Befreiung vom Feuer.
summaries.en: This hadith presents an Imam-based tafsir of the verses about the steep ascent and freeing a slave, interpreting them through the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. It teaches that acceptance of their wilayah is the path of salvation and deliverance from the Fire. The report highlights the theological significance of wilayah in relation to Quranic meaning and the afterlife.
summaries.es: Este hadiz presenta una tafsir basada en el Imam de las expresiones “al-ʿaqaba” y “fakku raqaba”, interpretándolas a través del wilayah de la Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام como el camino de la salvación y la liberación del Fuego.
summaries.fa: این حدیث تفسیری امام‌محور از «العقبة» و «فکّ رقبة» ارائه می‌کند و ولایت اهل‌بیت علیهم السلام را راه نجات و رهایی از آتش می‌داند.
summaries.fr: Ce hadith présente un tafsir fondé sur l’Imam des expressions « al-ʿaqaba » et « fakku raqaba », en les interprétant à travers la wilayah des Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام comme voie du salut et de la délivrance du Feu.
summaries.id: Hadis ini menyajikan tafsir berbasis Imam atas “al-ʿaqabah” dan “fakku raqabah”, dengan menafsirkan wilayah Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام sebagai jalan keselamatan dan pembebasan dari neraka.
summaries.ru: Этот хадис представляет имамоцентричный тафсир выражений «аль-ʿакаба» и «факку ракаба», истолковывая их через вилайю Ахль аль-Байт عليهم السلام как путь спасения и избавления от Огня.
summaries.tr: Bu hadis, “el-ʿakabe” ve “fekkü رقabe” ifadelerinin İmam merkezli tefsirini sunar; Ehl-i Beyt عليهم السلام’ın velayetini kurtuluş ve ateşten azat olma yolu olarak açıklar.
summaries.ur: یہ حدیث “العقبہ” اور “فکّ رقبة” کی امامی تفسیر پیش کرتی ہے، جس میں اہلِ بیت علیہم السلام کی ولایت کو نجات اور آگ سے رہائی کا راستہ بتایا گیا ہے۔
summaries.zh: 这段圣训对“العقبة”和“فكّرقبة”作了以伊玛目为中心的注释，将圣裔家族Ahlal-Bayt عليهم السلام的wilayah解释为获得拯救和脱离火狱之路。

text: قُلْتُ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ قَوْلُهُ فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ فَقَالَ مَنْ أَكْرَمَهُ اللَّهُ بِوَلَايَتِنَا فَقَدْ جَازَ الْعَقَبَةَ وَ نَحْنُ تِلْكَ الْعَقَبَةُ الَّتِي مَنِ اقْتَحَمَهَا نَجَا

قَالَ فَسَكَتَ فَقَالَ لِي فَهَلَّا أُفِيدُكَ حَرْفاً خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَ مَا فِيهَا قُلْتُ بَلَى جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ قَالَ قَوْلُهُ فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ النَّاسُ كُلُّهُمْ عَبِيدُ النَّارِ غَيْرَكَ وَ أَصْحَابِكَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ فَكَّ رِقَابَكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ بِوَلَايَتِنَا أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ .

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Suleyman Al Daylami, from his father, from Aban Bin Taghlub,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I said to himasws, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! Hisazwj Words [90:11] But he would not attempt the uphill road’. So heasws said: ‘The one whom Allahazwj has Honoured with ourasws Wilayah, so he has crossed the uphill road, and weasws are that uphill road which, one who attempts it, would attain salvation’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘So heasws was silent, then heasws said to me: ‘Shall Iasws give you a sentence (حَرْفاً ) which is better for you than the world and whatever is in it?’ I said, ‘Yes, may I be sacrificed for youasws!’ Heasws said: ‘Hisazwj Words [90:13] (It is) the setting free of a slave’. Then heasws said: ‘The people, all of them are slaves of the Fire, apart from you and your companions, for Allahazwj has Freed your necks from the Fire by ourasws Wilayah, of the Peopleasws of the Household’.
en.sarwar: 88. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from certain persons of our people from ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl who has said the following. “I asked abu al-Hassan al-Madi (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious. “They want to put out the light of God with their mouths,. .” [61:8] (The Imam (a.s.) siad, “They want to banish Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) with their mouths) “. . but God will certainly make His light shine forever. .” [61:8] (The Imam (a.s.) said, “Allah will complete Imamat (Leadership with Divine Authority) as He said in His words. “It is He who has sent His Messenger with guidance and the true religion,. .” [61:9] The Imam (a.s.) said, “It is He Who sent His Messenger with Wilaya for the executor of his will and Wilaya is the true religion.” I then read from the Holy Quran. “. . make the true religion to stand supreme over all religions, . .” [61:9] The Imam (a.s.) said, “He will it stand supreme at the time of (the rise of al-Mahdi with Divine Authority) as Allah has said, “. .He will make the true religion to stand supreme over all religions, (Wilaya of Al-Qa’im) even though the pagans may dislike it.” [61:9]. “The unbelievers refer to unbelievers in the Wilaya of Ali (a.s.)” said The Imam (a.s.). I then asked, “Is it revelation?” He replied, “These words are revelation but the others are interpretation.” I then read from the Holy Quran. “This is because they accepted the faith and then rejected. .” [63:3] The Imam (a.s.) said, “Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has called those who would not follow His Messenger in the matter of Wilaya hypocrites. He has considered those who reject Imamat just as those who would reject Muhammad (s.a) and to this effect He has revealed verses in the Holy Quran that read as herein below. “When the hypocrites (in the matter of Wilaya of the executor or your will, Ali (a.s.) come to you, they say, “We testify that you are the Messenger of God.” God knows that you are His Messenger. God testifies that they hypocrites (in the matters of Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) are liars ([63:1]. They have chosen their oaths as a shield for them to obstruct others from the way of God (the way is the executor of the will). How terrible is what they do! ([63:2]. This is because they accepted the faith (your message) and then rejected it (Wilaya of the executor of your will). God has sealed their hearts, thus, they do not have any understanding.” [63:3]. The narrator has said that I then asked, “What is the meaning of ‘they do not have any understanding.” [63:3]?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “Allah has said that they do not understand your prophesy.” I then asked about the meaning of Allah’s words. “When they are told, “Come and let the Prophet of God seek forgiveness for you,. .” [63:6] The Imam (a.s.) said, “It means that when the are asked to come back to the Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) so the The Holy Prophet (s.a) would ask Allah to forgive your sins, “. . they shake their heads (Allah says) and you can see them arrogantly turning away. . “ [63:6] (from the Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) “. . arrogantly. .”. ([63:5]. Allah then has reiterated His words about the fact that they know the Wilaya very well saying, “. . It is all the same whether you seek forgiveness for them or not; God will never forgive them. God does not guide the evil-doing people [63:6]. The Imam (a.s.) said, “It refers to the unjust ones against the executor of your will.” I then asked the Imam (a.s.) about the meaning of the words of Allah. “Can one who walks with his head hanging down be better guided that one who walks with his head upright?” [67:22] The Imam (a.s.) said, “Allah has compared the ones who would deviate from Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) to those who walk with teir head bent down without knowing what is around them. He, on the other hand has compared to those who would acknowledge Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) with those who would walk on the straight path. Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) is the straight path.” The narrator has said that I then asked The Imam (a.s.) about the words of Allah. “. . the Quran is certainly the word of a reverent messenger.” [69:40] The Imam (a.s.) said, “It is the words of Jibril from Allah about Wilaya of Ali (a.s.).” I then asked about the words of Allah. “It is not the word of a poet but only a few of you have faith,” [69:41] The Imam (a.s.) said, “They had said that Muhammad (s.a) is not truthful and Allah has not commanded him anything about Ali (a.s.). Allah then revealed Quran (a reading) about it. “It (Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) is a revelation from the Lord of the Universe [69:43]. “Had Muhammad invented some words against Us, [69:44]. We would have caught hold of him by his right hand [69:45] and cut-off his main artery.” [69:46]. Then Allah has turned to Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) saying, “The Quran (Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) is certainly a reminder for the (worlds) pious ones [69:48]. We certainly know that some of you have rejected it [69:49] and (on the Day of Judgment) this (Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) will be a great source of regret for the unbelievers [69:50]. This (Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) is the Truth beyond any doubt [69:51]. (Muhammad), glorify the name of your Lord, the Great One.” [69:52] Allah has said, “Thank your Lord, the Great, Who has granted you this distinction.” The narrator has said that I then asked The Imam (a.s.) about the words of Allah. “Now that we have listened to the guidance, we believe in it.. .” [72:13] The Imam (a.s.) said, “Guidance is Wilaya of Ali (a.s.). We have established faith in our guardian and those who would do so ‘. . Whoever believes in his Lord does not need to fear loss or oppression.” [72:13] I then asked, “Is it of the revealed words of Allah?” He said, “No, it is interpretation.” I then asked him about the words of Allah. “Say, “I do not possess any power to harm or benefit you.” [72:21] The Imam (a.s.) said, “the Messenger of Allah called people to acknowledge Wilaya of Ali (a.s.). Quraysh came to him and said, “O Muhammad, “Absolve us from such acknowledgment.” The Messenger of Allah said, “It is not from me but it is up to Allah.” They accused him and left him. Allah then revealed this reading. ““Say, “I do not possess any power to harm or benefit you. [72:21] Say, “No one can protect me from God, (if I would disobey Him) nor can I find any place of refuge but with him [72:22]. My only (means of protection) is to convey the message of God (about Ali (a.s.).. .” [72:23] I then asked, “Is it the revealed words of Allah?” He said, “Yes, it is the revealed word of Allah.” Allah has said to place more emphasis, “. . Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger (in the matters of Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) will go to hell, wherein he will live forever.” [72:23] I then read the words of Allah. “. . until the unbelievers witness that with which they have been threatened, they will then know whose helpers are weaker and fewer in number.” [72:24] It is a reference to the rise of al-Mahdi with Divine Authority and his supporters).” I then read the words of Allah. “ Bear patiently whatever they say,. .” [73:10] The Imam (a.s.) said, “They say, ‘. . and leave them to distance from them in an honorable manner.” [73:10] “Leave (O Muhammad) the prosperous unbelievers (in Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) to Me and give them respite for a little while;” [73:11] I then asked him, “Is it the revealed words of Allah?” He said, “Yes, it is.” I then read the words of Allah. “It gives more certainty to the people of the Book. .” [74:31] The Imam (a.s.) said, “They become certain that Allah, Hid Messenger and the executor of his will are true.” I then read, ‘. . and strengthens the faith of the believers.. . “ [74:31] The Imam (a.s.) said, “Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) strengthens their faith.” I then read the words of Allah. “. . The people of the Book and the believers have no doubt about it.. .” [74:31] The Imam (a.s.) said, “They have no doubts in the Wilaya of Ali (a.s.).” I then asked, “What is this doubt?” He said, “people of the Book and the believers that Allah has mentioned are meant thereby. He said that they do not doubt the Wilaya of Ali (a.s.).” I then read the words of Allah. “. . This parable is a reminder for mankind.” [74:31] The Imam (a.s.) said, “Yes, it the Wilaya of Ali (a.s.).” “. . it is certainly one of the two great things.” [74:35] The Imam (a.s.) said. “It is the Wilaya of Ali (a.s.).” I then read the words of Allah. “. whether one steps forward to embrace the faith or one turns away from it.” [74:37] The Imam (a.s.) one who would step forwards to our Wilaya he would step away from Hell and one who would step away from our Wilaya he would step closer to Hell.” I then read the words of Allah. “. . except the people of the right hand.” [74:39] The Imam (a.s.) said, “They, by Allah, are our Shi‘a (followers).” I then read the words of Allah. “. . We did not pray,” [74:43] The Imam (a.s.) said, “It refers to their saying, “We did not believe in Wilaya of Ali (a.s.) and the Imams after him and would offer the special greeting for them.” I then read the words of Allah. “. . Why do they run away from guidance,” [74:49] The Imam (a.s.) said, “It means running away from our Wilaya.” I then read the words of Allah. “There is no doubt that it is a guide.” [74:54] The Imam (a.s.) said, “It refers to Wilaya of Ali (a.s.).” I then read the words of Allah. “The servants of God fulfill their vows. .” [76:7] The Imam (a.s.) said, “They fulfill the vow and covenant that they had made to acknowledge our Wilaya.” I then read the words of Allah. “(Muhammad), We have revealed the Quran to you in gradual steps.” [76:23] The Imam (a.s.) said, “It means, revealed with Wilaya of Ali (a.s.).” I then asked, “Is it of the revealed words of Allah ?” He said, “Yes, with interpretation.” I then read the words of Allah. “This (chapter) is a reminder. . .”.[76:29] The Imam (a.s.) said, “It is a reminder of Wilaya .” I then read the words of Allah. “He admits to His mercy whomever He wants.. .” [76:31] The Imam (a.s.) said, “He admits in our Wilaya.” The Imam (a.s.) said, “. . For the unjust He has prepared a painful punishment.” [76:31] Consider that Allah has said, “They (children of Israel) did not wrong Us but wronged themselves. [2:57] The Imam (a.s.) said, “Allah is far glorious than to do injustice or ascribe injustice to His-self. However, Allah has confuse us with His-self, thus, He has called injustice to us as injustice to His-self and our Wilaya as His own Wilaya and guardianship. About this matter He revealed Quran (a reading) to His Prophet that reads. “We did not do any wrong to them but they wronged themselves. [16:118] I then asked, “Is it the revealed word of Allah ?” He said, “Yes, it is.” I then read the words of Allah. “On that day, woe will be to those who have rejected God’s revelations!” [77:15] (The Imam (a.s.) said, “Allah has said, “O Muhammad, woe is to those who reject what I have revealed about the Wilaya of Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.).” “Did We not destroy the ancient people [77:16] and make others settle after them in their land? [77:17]. The Imam (a.s.) said, “The ancient people are those who refused to obey the prophets about the executors of their will. “Thus do We deal with the sinful ones.” [77:18] The Imam (a.s.) said, “It refers to those who sinned in the matters of Ahl al-Bayt (family) of Muhammad (s.a) and did to them what they did.” I then read the words of Allah. “The pious ones . .” [77:41] The Imam (a.s.) said, “By Allah, only we and our Shi‘a (followers) follow truly the religion of Abraham/Ibrahim. Other people have no relationship with it.” I then read the words of Allah. “On that day, the Spirit and the angels who stand in lines will not speak . .” [78:38] The Imam (a.s.) said, “We, by Allah, on the Day of judgment will the permission to speak the truth.” I asked him, “What will you say when you will speak?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “We will praise our Lord, greet our The Holy Prophet (s.a) and intercede for our Shi‘a Our Lord will not reject our request.” I then read the words of Allah. “the records of the sinner’s deeds are in Sij4 n.” [83:7] The Imam (a.s.) said, “They are the ones who did injustice to the Imams and treated them with hostility.” I then read the words of Allah. “. .This is what you had called a lie.” [83:17] The Imam (a.s.) said, “It refers to Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.).” I then asked, “Is it the revealed word of Allah ?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “yes, it is.”
